title: Gloss Nametag Document
description: One nametag ruleset at plugins/Gloss/nametags/<id>.json. subject is the tagged player and viewer is the observer; a document that reads only subject.* resolves once per subject, one that reads viewer.* resolves per pair for nearby subjects.

schemaVersion.description: Document format version. Files on any other version are ignored.

revision.description: Server-owned monotonic revision, bumped on every write.

show.description: Condition deciding whether this document is eligible at all. A boolean or a boolean expression.

select.title: Nametag Selection
select.description: How this document competes with the other nametag documents. Highest priority wins, ties break by lowest id.

when.description: Condition deciding whether this document wants to tag the subject.

presentation.title: Nametag Presentation
presentation.description: The team style applied to the tagged player for this viewer.

prefix.description: Text before the player name. Runs through the full text pipeline.

suffix.description: Text after the player name. Runs through the full text pipeline.

color.description: Named text color applied to the player name and to any glow the same entry carries.

nameTagVisibility.description: Who sees the floating name above the player.

collision.description: Whether the tagged player pushes and is pushed.

variants.description: Alternative presentations for the same document. The highest-priority variant whose condition matches replaces the base presentation; variants never merge.

id.description: Variant id, unique inside this document.

priority.description: Variant priority; higher wins, ties break by lowest id.

when.description: Condition deciding whether this variant applies.
